newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PEKAO SA GROUP SEES 97 PRE-TAX PLN 1 BLN.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PEKAO SA GROUP SEES 97 PRE-TAX PLN 1 BLN.

text.p: The gross profit of Poland's state-owned commercial bank Pekao SA and its group of three banks is likely to top one billion zlotys in 1997, the bank's president Andrzej Dorosz told a news conference on Wednesday.
Since the group was only created late last year, no comparison group profit data was available.

Dorosz said the group, comprising also the state-owned commercial Pomorski Bank Kredytowy SA, Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA and Bank Depozytowo-Kredytowy SA was likely to reach a return on equity of 30 percent, similar to 1996.
He said that the main goal of the group, which is slated for privatisation in 1998, was to create a common computer system.
"We will buy a common computer system for all members of the group and build one data processing centre," Dorosz said, adding Pekao would announce a tender for the system this year.
He did not give specific numbers but said the cost of the investment would amount to "tens of millions of dollars over the next three to four years."
Dorosz also said he expected the four banks to sign in the middle of the year an agreement on setting up a common brokerage house.
